title: Lesson 01: The Grid
sources: Samsung Galaxy camera app: Camera settings > Grid lines (One UI)
Rule of thirds: a standard composition guideline (place the subject on a third line or intersection)

lines.text: Want better photos from your phone?
Open camera settings, and turn on grid lines.
Two lines across, two lines down, splitting your frame into thirds.
Now put your subject where the lines cross,
Keep your horizon on a line too, never through the middle.
lines.caps: KEEP YOUR *HORIZON | ON A *LINE | NEVER THE *MIDDLE

lines.text: Try it on your next walk, and tag me!
